text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the sporting goods store to do some shopping and spot two Tracen students browsing the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One of them is Little Cocon. Always cool with an air of cynicism about her, she has a bit of a sharp tongue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other is Bitter Glasse, a highly competitive runner who boasts supernatural strength and delights in harsh training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both are under the tutelage of my colleague Trainer Kashimoto. I never considered either of them to be the sociable type, though…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Trainer <username>! What a coincidence!
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you two together on your days off.
It's rare to see you two together on your days off.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: …That's none of your business. And we're not playing buddy-buddy anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Take it easy, Little Cocon… We came here today to exchange info.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon coldly turns away as Bitter Glasse explains the situation to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're sharing opinions on the equipment they've been using in order to suggest better options to Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We do trust Trainer Kashimoto, of course. She would never pick out anything inadequate.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But she's constantly looking at reviews of shoes, fitness wear, and stuff for our sakes.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: So we figured it'd be nice if we could make things a little easier for her. Our third year is getting closer, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yep. Our third year in the Twinkle Series, though I'm sure you're well aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: The last of the three most important years in an Umamusume's career.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: We gotta get our heads in the game. Oh yeah, I'm getting fired up!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: What about you? Do you really have time to be idling around here?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… If you slack off too much, you're going to slip up. That goes for you and your partner.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We'll be leaving now.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Haha, well, that's that! Say hi to <chrname> for us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While mulling over what they both said, I decide to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's late, and the only student still training is Happy Meek, the trainee of my colleague Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Happy Meek never says much, and her blank expression makes it look like she's always zoning out, but her bond with Trainer Kiryuin runs deep.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer <username>. Evening.
choice_data_list: Trainer Kiryuin isn't here with you?
Trainer Kiryuin isn't here with you?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: She's… holed up? In her office. Very busy.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I'm on break in the meantime… But I couldn't just stand around doing nothing.
choice_data_list: And that's why you're training this late?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Well… my trainer's "holed up" in her office…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: She's working hard to refine my third-year training regimen…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: So…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best, too… We're partners, after all…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Also… your partner was working hard too…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I'm off for another lap… Woo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something about what Happy Meek said weighs on my mind, so I head to my office.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Also… your partner was working hard too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Could <chrname> also be trying to think up a plan for her third year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In my office, I find…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend some time together discussing a variety of topics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tonight's events have helped me realize the strength of my bond with <chrname>!
